files-core.notes: gotzji covers only a narrow, project-scoped part of this family. What exists: registered-project management (registerProject/listManagedProjects/selectProject/projectContext, with registration kept on Desktop only), a bounded single-file text read (gotzji_read_file / readProjectFile / file.read.direct), a one-directory listing (gotzji_list_files / file.list), a literal text search (gotzji_search_files / file.search), whole-file write as a Core job (file.write through gotzji_prepare_operation/gotzji_submit), owner-registered reviewed commands (command.run) and a trusted directory-only folder picker. Missing entirely: move/copy/delete and Recovery Trash, checkpoints, batch reads, paged reads, workspace index/watch, context/full-scan/search_all aggregation, symbol navigation (find_*), repo_map, path_context, project profile, PDF tables and DOCX merge. The writer lease is held inside Core and is never exposed as owner or ChatGPT tools. lnwjud tools take absolute host paths. gotzji only takes the selected registered project and refuses traversal, junctions and private-runtime paths (product-file-reads.test.ts:185). All DEVELOPMENT_VERIFIED rows rest on ledger docs/codebase/2026-10-27-gotzji-windows-project-journey.md sections recorded at older successor heads (6e983493 baseline, fbd1d4517387 and later). None of the 24 CI receipts is for f791b383.
uncertainties: Every recorded pass cited is a ledger section from older successor heads (baseline 6e983493, fbd1d4517387 and later). No CI receipt is for f791b383. The DEVELOPMENT_VERIFIED rows could be STALE if file-read, write or command code changed later. This was not checked, to stay within budget.
It is unknown whether the execution-core product-file-reads and product-http suites belong to any recorded pass. The ledger sections record Desktop Vitest and Electron runs.
